queries_run: STMicroelectronics business model transition platform go-to-market change 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 經銷通路占營收 28%（2024 為 27%、2023 為 34%），通路結構近兩年大致穩定，未見結構性轉移；OEM 72%。
findings.excerpt: By market channel, our 2025 net revenues in Distribution amounted to 28% of our total consolidated revenues, increasing from 27% in 2024. When comparing 2024 with 2023 figures, net revenues in Distribution had decreased by 7%, from 34% to 27%.

findings.claim: 公司銷售組織以大客戶與區域銷售為主，大眾市場與經銷夥伴合作；區域銷售行銷組織維持不變，無商業模式轉型（訂閱／D2C）揭露。
findings.excerpt: The regional Sales & Marketing organization remained unchanged. We engage distributors and sales representatives to distribute and promote our products around the world.

findings.claim: 2026 上半年經銷占營收 29%（去年同期 28%）；Q2 財報稱經銷庫存低於標準目標。

note: 搜尋摘要提到 H1 2026 經銷占比 29%（上年同期 28%）、經銷庫存低於目標，見 clues；未找到訂閱化／D2C／平台化的一手來源。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
